design: A hulking adult ogre shaman with ochre-grey skin, huge belly and shoulders, small bald head with white tuft and two small lower tusks, narrow amber eyes and a smug hostile grimace. Blue ritual face-paint stripes, rough burgundy/teal fur-trimmed robe wrap, leather belt and wrist wraps, bone-bead necklace and heavy bare three-toed feet. Holds ONE SHORT carved wooden totem staff with a small horned animal skull top, no taller than his head in idle, visible in all16poses; other hand casts. Exactly two arms/two legs, no floating ornaments. Stylized cartoon fantasy brute matching player art, strong and imposing not cuddly. Idle feet fixed and heavy breathing/blink; hurt reels back retaining staff; attack winds casting hand then thrusts staff/hand toward RIGHT with no detached spell effect; dodge bends knees and leans back, recovery. Consistent staff/paint/clothes, wide margins.
